1651-1770-2638-6756-8344.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-1770-2638-6756-8344.notablePrerequisites:
Nog's second activated ability has been activated.
Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-1770-2638-6756-8344.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers twice due to Elesh Norn, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

618-3742-6495.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Phantom Steed.
When the Phantom Steed token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the Phantom Steed token.
When the Phantom Steed token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
618-3742-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1170-1976-4779-5131--202.description:

Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing the artifact, giving Krark-Clan Grunt +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn
Repeat.

206-3259-7605.description:
Cast Indulge by paying {2}{R}.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker. Indulge triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
206-3259-7605.notes: Afterwards, you can cast Excess from your graveyard for {1}{R} to create Treasures.

1394-2060-4050-4772-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Doubling Season.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Doubling Season.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

2366-5686-5929-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-5686-5929-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 3.

104-261-3490-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-261-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

413-586-3375-5258-5618.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger, adding {B}{B}{B} and untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

2906-4484-4871-5147-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2906-4484-4871-5147-5643.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
2906-4484-4871-5147-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Goblin Bombardment abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2906-4484-4871-5147-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

Cauldron Familiar and Chalk Outline trigger.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token and a Clue token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1618-3258-6496--97.easyPrerequisites: You have a storm count of 1 if the self-suspending card is not in your hand, or a storm count of 0 otherwise.
1618-3258-6496--97.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Beacon of Tomorrows and the self-suspending card, if needed, during the first turn.
1618-3258-6496--97.description:
Cast the self-suspending card by paying its mana cost if its in your hand, or any other spell otherwise if you have not cast a spell this turn.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Beacon of Tomorrows and then exiling it with four time counters on it and giving it suspend.
Resolve the copy of Beacon of Tomorrows, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of that turn's upkeep, Beacon of Tomorrows and the self-suspending card's suspend abilities trigger, removing a time counter from each of them.
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing three time counters from Beacon of Tomorrows and the self-suspending card, triggering their suspend abilities.
Resolve the self-suspending card's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost, and eventually exile it with time counters on it.
Resolve the Beacon of Tomorrows's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.
1618-3258-6496--97.notes: It is highly recommended to choose a self-suspending card that you are certain will have legal targets, if applicable, every time it is cast.

2438-3090-5434-5555.description:

During the opponent's turn, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 2.

654-5413-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Lands you control and/or land cards in your graveyard that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
654-5413-5720-5721.description:
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

575-5147-5624.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Nervous Gardener.
When Nervous Gardener dies, Yedora triggers, returning Nervous Gardener from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Nervous Gardener by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Nervous Gardener's disguise ability by paying {G}, turning it face-up.
Nervous Gardener triggers, causing you to search your library for a land with a basic land type and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

222-629-4871-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Saproling.
222-629-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Gruff Triplets and Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Gruff Triplets die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice and Gruff Triplets' second ability triggers once.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Gruff Triplets trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Gruff Triplets' power on each creature you control named Gruff Triplets.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia abilities, causing target player to mill cards equal to Gruff Triplets and Slimefoot and Squee's combined power.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two in any combination of {B}, {R} or {G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and Gruff Triplets from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Slimefoot and Squue and Gruff Triplets' second ability triggers.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the Gruff Triplets trigger, creating two token copes of it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a Gruff Triplets token.
When the Gruff Triplets token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the Gruff Triplets token's power.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

372-1917-3742.description:
Cast Phantom Steed by paying {3}{U}.
When Phantom Steed enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Touch the Spirit Realm to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Touch the Spirit Realm enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Phantom Steed until Touch the Spirit Realm leaves the battlefield.
Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Abdel Adrian to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Touch the Spirit Realm and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Touch the Spirit Realm leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Phantom Steed to return from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3985-4343.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional untapped creature.
2034-3985-4343.description:
Activate Opposition by tapping an untapped creature you control, tapping a creature an opponent controls.
Hylda of the Icy Crown triggers, holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature tapped in step 1, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Hylda of the Icy Crown trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 4/4 Elemental creature token.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop during each turn.

914-1075-2068-5147.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1075-2068-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, targeting any applicable target.
Ashnod the Uncaring triggers, copying Goblin Bombardment's ability, targeting any applicable target.
Resolve both Goblin Bombardment abilities, dealing 1 damage to any target twice.
Activate Bonecaller Cleric by paying {3}{B} and sacrificing it, targeting Dockside Extortionist.
Ashnod the Uncaring triggers, copying Bonecaller Cleric's ability, with the copy targeting Bonecaller Cleric.
Resolve both Bonecaller Cleric abilities, returning it and Dockside Extortionist to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.
If opponents control four or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

1822-3089-4659-4840.description:
Cast Myr Battlesphere by paying {7}.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating eight 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks five times by sacrificing five Myrs, adding ten {C}.
Activate Barrin by paying {2} and sacrificing a Myr, returning Myr Battlesphere to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

The Triskelavite enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding {C} for each Triskelavite you control.
Activate a Triskelavite by sacrificing it, targeting Triskelavus.

2060-2178-2738-4170.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Fain.

2060-2178-2738-4170.description:
Activate Fain's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
 Tenacious Dead dies, triggering itself and Fain.
Resolve the Fain trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, causing you to pay {1}{B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Fain ability from step 1, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two counters from it, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

539-1409-4482-4637.description:
Pay {1}{U} to exile and return Omnath to the battlefield.
Soulbond Omnath with Deadeye Navigator.
Omnath enters, triggering its own landfall ability twice, drawing a card, gaining 4 life, and adding {U}{R}{W}{G}.
